This article introduces the process for purchasing the DataAgent product online.

<span id="ced27093"></span>
# Purchase process

<div data-tips="true" data-tips-type="warning" data-tips-is-title="true">warning</div>


<div data-tips="true" data-tips-type="warning">Regardless of whether you have signed a contract offline, you must complete the product purchase online; <strong>this process cannot be omitted</strong>.</div>


<img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," />

<span id="e029fd2c"></span>
# Prerequisites


* A BytePlus account has been registered. If you have not registered a BytePlusnt, please complete [account registration](https://console.volcengine.com/auth/signup) first. You can refer to the [account registration process](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6261/64925).

* Enterprise real\-name authentication has been completed. If you have not completed enterprise real\-name authentication, please complete [real-name authentication](https://console.volcengine.com/user/authentication/detail/) first. You can refer to the [enterprise authentication process](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6261/64937).


<span id="ef9e1dbe"></span>
# Notes


* For billing information regarding paid purchases of DataAgent, see [Billing for BytePlus DataAgent Products and Services](https://docs.byteplus.com/docs/dataagent/Billing_for_BytePlus_DataAgent_Products_and_Services).

* If you have any questions, please contact BytePlus. Contact phone: 400\-850\-0030.


<span id="fcb00f2f"></span>
# Purchase SaaS edition

<span id="5b069d2e"></span>
### Confirm contract

If you have already negotiated and confirmed the intention to cooperate with BytePlus, once both parties reach an agreement, BytePlus will send the agreed contract to you via internal message and email as per the agreement. Upon receipt, follow these steps:


1. Go to [the BytePlus official website](https://www.byteplus.com/en) and click "Log in". Log in to BytePlus using the registered account and password.


<span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/7679c6b3d2d946bf8a54db08293cc07c~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>


2. Go to the "Console" page. Click "Console" in the upper right corner.


<span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/916727271e764d599908c9dc15b104ec~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>


3. Go to the Billing Center page. Click "Billing" \- "Account Overview" to enter the Billing Center.


<span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/c0bda8f2966e4fada6c4324be5227640~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>


4. On the "Account Overview" page, click "Confirm" to go to the "Contract Management" page.


<span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/ee891d8aaf264955b72fbfdfc46252bb~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>


5. On the "Contract Management" page, locate the quotation contract and download it for review. After confirming there are no errors, click "Agree"; if you do not agree, click "Reject" and you can further discuss the contract with the BytePlus team.


<span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/d17f127ef5b14b73b8cc9cf84001db2e~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>


6. Wait for the contract to be generated; no action is required. After the contract takes effect, you can click "Download" to view the contract. At this time, the contract is a PDF file stamped with our electronic seal.


<span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/b53f5ff6b29f4e65ba2a1f0a620a6cad~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>

<span id="0681bb8f"></span>
### Recharge and remittance

<div data-tips="true" data-tips-type="warning" data-tips-is-title="true">warning</div>


<div data-tips="true" data-tips-type="warning">When making payment, you must go to "Console" \- "Billing Center" to complete the payment; corporate payments cannot be made separately.</div>



1. Log in to [the BytePlus Console](https://console.byteplus.com/user/basics/) using your account and password, and click "Billing" \- "Account Overview" in the upper right corner.


<span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/c0bda8f2966e4fada6c4324be5227640~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>


2. Complete the recharge. BytePlus supports two recharge methods: "Online Recharge" and "Offline Remittance". For corporate transfers, the "Offline Remittance" method can be used. Due to bank processing times, there may be delays in the arrival of funds when using offline remittance methods. Funds typically arrive within one day, with the fastest being two hours. For detailed instructions, refer to [Recharge operation guide](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6269/100434).

   <div data-tips="true" data-tips-type="warning" data-tips-is-title="true" data-wrapper-indent="1">warning   </div>
   

   <div data-tips="true" data-tips-type="warning" data-wrapper-indent="1">Starting April 8, 2024, only offline remittances with the same name as the dedicated account can be automatically credited by the system; other offline remittances require a "Remittance Claim" operation for funds to be credited. For details, see <a href="https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6269/1231124">Remittance Claim Operation Manual</a>.   </div>
   

<span id="1f187913"></span>
### Order and payment

<div data-tips="true" data-tips-type="warning" data-tips-is-title="true">warning</div>


<div data-tips="true" data-tips-type="warning">If you have agreed on a price with BytePlus through a contract, ensure the contract is in effect before placing an order to ensure the agreed price applies.</div>



1. Go to the DataAgent product page, click "Product Experience", and open the purchase page.

2. On the purchase page, select the Agent product service and resource package service you wish to purchase, confirm, and then click "Buy Now". For billing instructions, see [Billing for BytePlus DataAgent Products and Services](https://docs.byteplus.com/docs/dataagent/Billing_for_BytePlus_DataAgent_Products_and_Services).

3. Follow the prompts in the order and payment process to complete "Confirm order information", "Submit payment information", and "Payment completed" in sequence. In the "Submit payment information" step, select "Available balance payment" as the payment method to use the balance recharged in your account for product payment.


<span id="1b12d3ec"></span>
# Purchase the on\-premises version

To use the DataAgent product in an on\-premises deployment mode, contact the BytePlus business team for consultation.
